definitions.ratio: Sparkgap/vLLM: TTFT lower is faster; throughput higher is faster.
definitions.throughput: Frozen harness metric: sum(actual output counts minus one per request)/(last delivered token chunk minus earliest first delivered token chunk). If the first chunk contains k>1 IDs, k-1 numerator tokens were already delivered at the first timestamp; counts are recorded explicitly. This is not exact per-token delivery throughput.
definitions.prefill: prompt tokens/delivery TTFT for cold4096/65536 cases; includes frontend, sampling and delivery, not isolated GPU prefill.
definitions.coalescing: A chunk arrival is not an individual token-generation timestamp; exact ITL comparison is omitted if either stream coalesces IDs.
definitions.cache: Identical request inputs may restore different actual prefix extents; such TTFT ratios are end-to-end policy comparisons, not equal-work suffix comparisons.
definitions.clocks: Only delivery clocks are paired. Sparkgap core observations remain unpaired; delivery includes backend-dependent observation overhead.
definitions.concurrency: The batch field is requested HTTP concurrency; actual GPU batch composition requires separate execution traces.
definitions.arithmetic: Backend/library/tuning policies are preserved as provenance, not asserted equivalent. Output-ID differences are reported without an invented numerical gate.
definitions.coverage: Invalid groups and unequal actual output sequences do not supply paired ratios. Both standalone delivery measurements and output-ID differences remain recorded; incomplete evidence stays labeled incomplete.
definitions.workload: Synthetic numbered-list/apple shape matrix; not a representative MTP acceptance or task-quality corpus.

scope.audit_execution: CPU-only source/receipt inspection; no inference, CUDA initialization, or runtime changes
limitations: The 512-token vLLM launch has cache-hit logs, not a fresh per-layer selected-plan dump. Its selections are reconstructed from pinned cache keys and the matching historical worker queries.
Candidate eligibility is semantic policy, not a tuning interruption. The 17 legal Sparkgap decode MoE candidates were all measured.
No paired operator timing experiment is included. These differences do not assign a cause or magnitude to end-to-end performance differences.
The 4096-token vLLM launch compiles/tunes additional GDN shapes; startup cache warmth is capacity-specific.
